name: PT Citra Borneo Utama Tbk
summary: Operating both within Indonesia and internationally, PT Citra Borneo Utama Tbk specializes in the refining, fractionation, and trading of palm oil. The company provides a range of products, including refined bleached deodorized palm oil, refined bleached deodorized palm olein, refined bleached deodorized palm stearin, palm fatty acid distillate, crude palm kernel oil, and palm kernel expeller. Founded in 2013, its corporate headquarters are located in Kumai, Indonesia. PT Citra Borneo Utama Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Citra Borneo Indah.
